About Sreenidhi

I turn early questions into products people can actually use.

A product strategist and designer working across research, product direction, experience design, and delivery.

Scroll to read

Right now, at BD4, I help shape an AI-powered product from early exploration all the way through launch, staying close to the decisions that connect what people need, what the business is chasing, and what the technology can honestly do.

Lately that means real R&D into practical applications of LLMs and machine-learning models: reasoning, recommendation, and classification systems, the kind of work that makes a product more useful, more affordable to run, and safer to trust.

10+
products & core initiatives shaped end to end

I'm at my best in rooms full of ambition.

I'm energized by people who are building, questioning, and pushing ideas forward. Networking, for me, was never about collecting contacts. It's how I find new perspectives, trade possibilities, and pick up the momentum to actually make something happen.

Outside the work, my world fills up with public speaking and half-formed side ideas, interior design and the feel of a room, culture and travel, podcasts playing beside unfinished drawings, and conversations that keep going long after everyone's left.

The way I design comes from the way I notice.
